channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Mechanic jailed 22 months for kicking kitten to death
item.description: SHAH ALAM: A mechanic whose video of kicking and throwing a kitten to death went viral last year was sentenced to 22 months’ jailby the Sessions Court here today after failing to pay a RM60,000 fine.

item.title: MACC probes Sunway's acquisition of IJM shares
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC) has opened a new investigation into alleged irregularities involving conglomerate IJM Corporation Bhd, this time focusing on Sunway Bhd’s recent acquisition of shares in the company.

item.title: 'Don't field Heritage 7 against Vietnam', Safee warns Harimau Malaya
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Former international Safee Sali has warned Harimau Malaya against fielding seven “heritage” players for the crucial Asian Cup qualifier against Vietnam, as their eligibility remains the subject of a pending Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) appeal.

item.title: Police probe alleged plan to demolish Hindu temple in Penang
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: Police have launched an investigation after Jelutong Member of Parliament RSN Rayer lodged a report over a Facebook post alleging a plan to demolish a Hindu temple in Penang.

item.title: North Korea unveils rare statue of leader Kim Jong Un
item.description: PYONGYANG, (North Korea): North Korea has unveiled one of its first-known statues of Kim Jong Un, using the “highly unusual” sculpture to depict the leader as a smiling man of the people, an analyst told AFP.

item.title: Walmart-backed PhonePe targets up to US$10.5bil valuation in India IPO
item.description: MUMBAI: Walmart-backed Indian fintech firm PhonePe, the country’s most used payments platform, is aiming to list at a valuation of between US$9 billion and US$10.5 billion, two people with direct knowledge of the matter said.

item.title: Bank of Japan chief vows to keep raising rates with eye on Iran conflict
item.description: TOKYO: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said the central bank will continue to raise interest rates if its economic forecasts materialise, but warned of the potential hit to global growth from the Middle East conflict that required vigilance.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Janna Nick recalls suspicious incident amid celebrity scam controversy
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Popular actress and singer Janna Nick has sparked a flurry of speculation online after sharing a peculiar encounter involving a fellow celebrity allegedly linked to a burgeoning financial scandal.

item.title: Sabah twins paint tribute to rich marine world at new jetty
item.description: KOTA KINABALU: The newly opened South Jetty at Kota Kinabalu Port has been given a splash of colour and life, featuring what could be the city’s largest mural.

item.title: Farm Fresh director killed in helicopter crash in Philippines
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Farm Fresh Bhd farm director Jacob Mathan has died following a helicopter crash in the Philippines.
